payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the amount of additional data generated from translations, particularly highlighting the effectiveness of using multiple back-translations to improve data quality.

claims.text: The additional data generated from translations is about 10 times larger than the 2-votes data used in the experiment.
Using back-translations where at least two agree yields the best quality of additional data.
The method of using multiple translations improves the quality of the additional data significantly compared to using data from just one language.
